ajustes.texto: Before cancelling, each student tells you why. You can also offer them a way to stay.
ajustes.pausaAyuda: During the pause they don't pay and can't access the content; their account and progress stay, and it restarts on its own. One pause per person per year. Not offered on yearly plans.
ajustes.descuentoAyuda: It applies to their next monthly payments (on quarterly or yearly plans, to the next renewal). Once per person.
